name: CN Tower
description: A concrete communications tower with glass-floor lookouts above downtown Toronto.

name: Château Frontenac
description: A landmark railway hotel crowns the cliff above Old Québec’s terrasses.

name: Parliament Hill
description: Gothic Revival parliament buildings overlook the Ottawa River with a Peace Tower.

name: Notre-Dame Basilica
description: A Gothic Revival basilica with a vividly coloured interior on Place d’Armes.

name: Stanley Park totem poles
description: Coast Salish and other First Nations poles stand at Brockton Point in Stanley Park.

name: Niagara Falls (Horseshoe)
description: The Canadian Horseshoe Falls thunder into the Niagara River gorge.

name: Banff National Park
description: Rocky Mountain peaks, lakes and hot springs in Canada’s first national park.

name: Old Québec
description: Fortified streets and terraces form a UNESCO historic district above the St. Lawrence.

name: Capilano Suspension Bridge
description: A pedestrian suspension bridge spans a rainforest canyon north of Vancouver.

name: Peggy’s Cove
description: A lighthouse sits on granite shoreline southwest of Halifax.

name: St. Lawrence Market
description: A historic market south of downtown known for peameal bacon sandwiches and produce.

name: Granville Island Public Market
description: An indoor market under the Granville Bridge sells produce and ready-to-eat counters.

name: Jean-Talon Market
description: One of Canada’s large open-air markets in Montreal’s Little Italy.

name: ByWard Market
description: Outdoor stalls and restaurants surround Ottawa’s historic ByWard Market building.

name: Kensington cafés
description: A riverside neighbourhood of cafés and casual kitchens northwest of downtown Calgary.

name: Calgary Stampede
description: A July rodeo, exhibition and parade billed as the Calgary Stampede.
